backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining Booking and Review types with CRUD operations (add, get, update, delete) stored in in-memory Maps, including filtering by service type and rating.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs to their associated source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for the TrustFix frontend.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key changes of every component and page in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, chart, sidebar variables).
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the TrustFix React SPA with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div mounting point for the Vite/React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for Home, Services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, Booking, Contact, and Reviews pages, all wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AddOnOptions.tsx: Interactive add-on options selector component that toggles optional service upgrades (emergency, holiday, warranty), tracks selection state, and reports selected add-ons and total extra cost via an onChange callback.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: A modal popup component that renders a booking form with fields for name, mobile, address, service, property type, date/time, and notes, then formats the data into a WhatsApp message and opens the chat link on submission.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: A card component for displaying a cleaning service with image, price, description, and features, offering WhatsApp chat and Book Now action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ExpandedServiceP: A panel component that renders service items within a category, supporting per-sqft pricing calculators, add-on options, and WhatsApp booking or form popup actions per item.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Fetches and displays featured customer reviews from the backend in a responsive grid of review cards, falling back to static hardcoded reviews if none are returned.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: A fixed floating button in the bottom-left corner that opens a WhatsApp link when clicked, styled as a phone/call icon.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button in the bottom-right corner with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link on click.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer displaying the TrustFix brand, contact details, address, social links, a list of service category links, and quick navigation links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Renders the homepage hero banner with a background image, headline, and two CTA buttons (Book Service, Call Now) that open WhatsApp with pre-filled messages.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps page content with Navbar, Footer, and a floating WhatsApp button, and scrolls to top on route changes.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, a search dropdown that filters services and redirects to the services page, and a WhatsApp call button.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: Card component for painting services displaying image, fixed price, description, up to 3 features, and WhatsApp/Book Now action buttons.
Card component for pest control services that detects per-sq.ft pricing based on service metadata and displays the appropriate price format alongside WhatsApp/Book Now buttons.
frontend/src/components/PricingCalculato: Interactive calculator that takes a square footage input and multiplies it by a given per-sqft rate to display the estimated total price for a service.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a single customer review with avatar initials, star rating, service label, formatted date, and review text.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Generic service card showing image, fixed price, description, up to 3 features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons for non-pest-control services.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCardWithE: A service category card component with scroll-reveal animation and staggered entrance that toggles an expanded panel showing detailed services when clicked.
Renders a grid of service category buttons that navigate to filtered service pages, plus a WhatsApp contact button.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Displays a responsive grid of service categories with scroll-triggered staggered fade-in animations, each linking to the services page filtered by category.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: A reusable star rating display component that supports optional interactive rating selection and configurable size.
A card component for individual services showing image, price, features, and action buttons for WhatsApp contact or booking, with scroll-reveal animation.
A form component for submitting customer reviews with name, service type, star rating, and text fields, persisted via a backend actor mutation.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines all service data types, category ordering, and the full services catalog (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.) along with WhatsApp link helpers and add-on options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
React Query mutation hook that submits a booking to the backend actor and, on success, invalidates the bookings cache and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message in a new tab.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeUpOnScroll.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling a fade-up animation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage ICP AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and expose identity state and status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines three React Query hooks—useGetFeaturedReviews, useGetAllReviews, and useGetAllBookings—that fetch data from the backend actor when it is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Memoized hook that searches through the services data by query string, matching category names and individual service names/descriptions, and returns up to 8 deduplicated results.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Inter fonts, configures Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and adds custom component styles such as WhatsApp float button, fade-up scroll animations, and wave-pop keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Booking page component with a form for selecting service, property type, date, time, and contact details that composes a WhatsApp message and opens it in a new tab on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page that displays clickable cards for WhatsApp, phone, address, and email contact options, along with working hours information.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main Home page component that renders the hero section, animated stats bar, scroll-revealed service cards with expand/collapse behavior, a 'Why Choose Us' section, featured reviews carousel, and a WhatsApp CTA footer.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Displays all customer reviews fetched from the backend actor in a responsive grid with skeleton loading states, and includes a WriteReviewForm sidebar for submitting new reviews.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services page with sticky category tabs that filter and display service cards (using specialized card components for pest control, cleaning, and painting), and opens a BookingFormPopup when a service is selected.
frontend/src/utils/whatsappHelper.ts: Utility functions that build a formatted WhatsApp booking message (including add-ons and sq.ft pricing) and generate the corresponding wa.me URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom brand colors, CSS variable-based semantic colors, typography, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations (fadeInUp, wave, pulse-slow).
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the current version, feature list, architectural notes, and known issues for the TrustFix home services app.
